baseline_boundary: The historical TypeScript 5.9 protocol remains authoritative; a newer parser does not widen accepted input or proof scope.

upstreams.version_evidence: Official semantic Cargo.toml history goes 0.146.0 directly to 0.147.0; the latter requires Rust 1.96.0. No intermediate patch observed. This is source-declared compatibility, not a compiled dependency-closure result.

upstreams.status: GitHub archive since 2025-03-12; main source commit dated 2023-11-17
README declares insufficient feature support for existing projects and no TSC parity; no compilation evaluated

upstreams.finding: Official document says file-by-file transpilation, incomplete imported type/value discrimination, and no type checking. This does not assess the separate STC checker.

operation_groups.available_library_mechanisms: Oxc AST/parser plus lexical Scoping, declaration/redeclaration IDs, source spans, optional JSDoc, syntax diagnostics and CFG.
operation_groups.owned_missing_work: Extraction DTOs, stable identities/ordering, overload projection, source-coordinate contract, source JSDoc association and exact historical diagnostic/discovery behavior.

operation_groups.available_library_mechanisms: Oxc resolver has FileSystem injection; resolve/resolve_file/resolve_with_context, tsconfig discovery/inheritance/references, paths/baseUrl and ESM/CJS package resolution. resolve_dts documents bundler declaration resolution.
operation_groups.owned_missing_work: Historical compiler-option policy and selected input universe, confined retained filesystem, Windows canonical identity, source/runtime/declaration companion mapping and failure/refusal translation. Resolver option support is not a full TS CompilerHost/Program replacement.

operation_groups.available_library_mechanisms: Oxc binds lexical identifiers, records Type/ValueAsType/Namespace and Read/Write reference flags, declarations and local node identity. STC exposes full dependency checking and module types; Ezno exposes project checking, type stores, exports, expression mappings and source spans.
operation_groups.owned_missing_work: For an Oxc-based approach: multi-file canonical export/alias linking; contextual types, overload/generic call endpoint selection and declaration origin; SDK callback semantics, semantic JSDoc imports and generated-runtime policy. The inspected Oxc APIs do not provide these TypeChecker-like operations. STC/Ezno still need an adapter and behavioral qualification; their APIs are not TS Compiler API compatibility claims.

operation_groups.available_library_mechanisms: AST, lexical binding and optional CFG are inputs; the alternative checkers expose richer type/flow data.
operation_groups.owned_missing_work: Semctx admission, reflection/mutation/protocol, opaque ownership and external runtime policy remain owned analyses; no upstream evidence inspected establishes those guarantees.

operation_groups.available_library_mechanisms: Parsing/resolution/lexical references provide dependency candidates; toolchain/crate commit metadata can identify implementations.
operation_groups.owned_missing_work: Selected-language/role policy, dependency-connected partitioning, batch/worker DTOs, deterministic serialization, retained source/config identities and refusal states.

early_risk_witness_categories_not_select: Cross-file aliases/reexports/star ambiguity/cycles and namespace-member calls must retain one canonical endpoint or the exact refusal; lexical resolution alone cannot establish this.
Overload/generic/contextual SDK callback signatures through .d.ts and nested type aliases must retain declaration origin and distinguish homonymous local symbols.
JS semantic JSDoc import types and JSX implicit factory/runtime bindings must preserve the historical TS5.9 interpretation.
Windows native source/config/package identity, symlinks or junctions and non-ASCII source-coordinate mapping must match the retained universe and output contract.
Missing/ambiguous/malformed source or config, unsupported constructs, invalid imports and type-uncertain calls must expose explicit omissions/refusals rather than fabricate facts.
